text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...'Magnificent' is the only word that fits.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Her progress is exceptionally good.
In fact, thanks to thorough rehabilitation,
she's become far sturdier than before.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...My, my. An Umamusume's body truly is
full of mysterious potential, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Of course, bringing that out was only
possible thanks to both of your dedicated efforts,
but still—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Teacher!
Thank you so, so much as well!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I've received so, so much Marvelous
from you too, Teacher☆

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
...At any rate, as I was saying.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"The Challenge Cup—
with this, there's nothing to worry about."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please, go and run with all your might.
...We are looking forward to seeing you in action.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Hehehe, Trainer, Trainer, Trainer☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing hurts anymore! I don't feel a thing!
Not left, not right, and not up, down, front, or back either☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of my body, my chest is
thumping and pounding like crazy!
But that's just 'cause I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —This is so exciting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I can run.
I can run with ev-ery-thing I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Finally, finally!
I can share all the Marvelous with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday, fully recovered.
Filling her heart with marvelousness and devoting herself to rehab,
there were no longer any worries holding her back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Let us take on the Challenge Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading out, Trainer!!
